'''Victor Bolling''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Minneapolis tournament (13 January)]] on 13 January 2001 with [[Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|Agents in the Court/Eloms]], according to Justin Alfs's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1624">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-14-moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-1-13d1624/ moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-1-13], DeckTech (Justin "MoffWicket" Alfs, 14 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-14-moffwicket-goes-to-mirkwood-1-13d1624/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
